Rule Label Resource Delete Rule Label
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/ruleLabels/:ruleLabelId

Deletes the rule label for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ruleLabelId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the rule label.

Responses
​
